parameters.query:
with hoje as (
  select
    (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date as dia,
    extract(year from (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'))::int as ano,
    extract(month from (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'))::int as mes,
    extract(day from (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'))::int as dia_do_mes
),
semana_atual as (
  select case
    when h.dia_do_mes <= 7 then 1
    when h.dia_do_mes <= 14 then 2
    when h.dia_do_mes <= 21 then 3
    else 4
  end as semana
  from hoje h
),
dias_no_mes as (
  select extract(day from (make_date(h.ano, h.mes, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day'))::int as total
  from hoje h
),
vendas_hoje as (
  select
    v.codigo_vendedor,
    count(*) filter (
      where v.codigo_cliente is not null
        and not (
          vd.numero_cpf is not null
          and c.numero_cpf_cnpj is not null
          and regexp_replace(c.numero_cpf_cnpj, '\\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(vd.numero_cpf, '\\D', '', 'g')
        )
    ) as vendas_cliente_real,
    count(*) filter (
      where v.codigo_cliente is not null
        and vd.numero_cpf is not null
        and c.numero_cpf_cnpj is not null
        and regexp_replace(c.numero_cpf_cnpj, '\\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(vd.numero_cpf, '\\D', '', 'g')
    ) as vendas_proprio_cpf,
    count(*) filter (where v.codigo_cliente is null) as vendas_sem_cliente
  from vendas v
  join hoje h on true
  left join vendedores vd on vd.codigo = v.codigo_vendedor
  left join clientes c on c.codigo = v.codigo_cliente
  where v.data_emissao = h.dia
  group by v.codigo_vendedor
),
meta_mensal as (
  select mp.codigo_vendedor, mp.valor_meta as meta_mensal
  from vw_metas_progresso mp, hoje h
  where mp.ano = h.ano and mp.mes = h.mes and mp.semana is null
),
meta_semanal as (
  select mp.codigo_vendedor, mp.valor_meta as meta_semana, mp.valor_realizado as margem_semana
  from vw_metas_progresso mp, hoje h, semana_atual s
  where mp.ano = h.ano and mp.mes = h.mes and mp.semana = s.semana
),
atividade_hoje as (
  select
    p.codigo_vendedor,
    exists (
      select 1 from produtos_em_falta pef
      where pef.registrado_por = p.id and pef.data = h.dia
    ) as lancou_falta,
    exists (
      select 1 from contatos_clientes cc
      where cc.codigo_vendedor = p.codigo_vendedor
        and cc.contatado_em::date = h.dia
        and cc.tipo_contato in ('whatsapp', 'ligacao')
    ) as fez_contato
  from profiles p
  cross join hoje h
  where p.codigo_vendedor is not null
)
select
  vd.codigo as codigo_vendedor,
  vd.nome as nome_vendedor,
  coalesce(mv.faturamento_liquido, 0) - coalesce(mv.total_custo, 0) as margem_dia,
  coalesce(mv.qtd_notas, 0) as qtd_notas_dia,
  coalesce(vh.vendas_cliente_real, 0) as vendas_cliente_real,
  coalesce(vh.vendas_proprio_cpf, 0) as vendas_proprio_cpf,
  coalesce(vh.vendas_sem_cliente, 0) as vendas_sem_cliente,
  round(mm.meta_mensal / nullif(dnm.total, 0), 2) as meta_dia,
  round(
    (coalesce(mv.faturamento_liquido,0) - coalesce(mv.total_custo,0))
    / nullif(mm.meta_mensal / nullif(dnm.total,0), 0) * 100
  , 1) as percentual_dia,
  ms.margem_semana,
  ms.meta_semana,
  round(ms.margem_semana / nullif(ms.meta_semana,0) * 100, 1) as percentual_semana,
  faixa_sem.percentual_comissao as faixa_semana,
  coalesce(ah.lancou_falta, false) as lancou_falta,
  coalesce(ah.fez_contato, false) as fez_contato
from vw_vendedores_ativos vd
cross join hoje h
cross join dias_no_mes dnm
left join vw_metricas_vendedor_diario mv on mv.codigo_vendedor = vd.codigo and mv.data_emissao = h.dia
left join vendas_hoje vh on vh.codigo_vendedor = vd.codigo
left join meta_mensal mm on mm.codigo_vendedor = vd.codigo
left join meta_semanal ms on ms.codigo_vendedor = vd.codigo
left join atividade_hoje ah on ah.codigo_vendedor = vd.codigo
left join lateral (
  select percentual_comissao
  from faixas_comissao
  where percentual_meta_min <= coalesce(round(ms.margem_semana / nullif(ms.meta_semana,0) * 100, 1), 0)
  order by percentual_meta_min desc
  limit 1
) faixa_sem on true
order by margem_dia desc nulls last;
